title: The number of measures on very large measurable cardinals
summary: We study the possible number of normal measures on a measurable cardinal in settings where inner model techniques are unavailable. Instead, we exploit consequences of the Ultrapower Axiom to obtain our theorems. We show that the classical Kimchi-Magidor result -that the first $n$ measurable cardinals can be strongly compact- can be combined with an arbitrary prescribed pattern for the number of normal measures they carry.
